en.metin: 6 November: 71 earthquakes were recorded in and around Turkey; 1 of magnitude 3 or more, the largest 3.3. 5 November: breathing Istanbul's air for a day was roughly equal to 0.3 cigarettes in fine particles (PM2.5). The water-covered area of Istanbul's 10 reservoirs is 85% of their fullest, measured by satellite (area, not volume). 4 November: sea water along Turkey's coasts was 0.5 °C warmer than the 1991–2020 average; 34 of 41 points were warmer than normal. 5 November: the article that suddenly drew the most readers on Turkish Wikipedia was "Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya": 30,157 views, about 19 times its usual day.

en.metin: On 4 November, 90 earthquakes were recorded in and around Turkey, largest 2.3, none reaching magnitude 3, and breathing Istanbul's air for a day was roughly equal to 0.6 cigarettes in fine particles (PM2.5). Istanbul's 10 reservoirs are at 85% of fullest water-covered area by satellite (area, not volume). On 3 November, sea water along Turkey's coasts was 0.3 °C warmer than the 1991–2020 average; 29 of 41 points warmer than normal. On 4 November, "Ahmet Nazif Zorlu" led Turkish Wikipedia with 27,616 views, about 363 times its usual day.
